text: Let's look together. Listen for the next piece, then tap its picture.
Let's build a bird nest! Gather the twigs to make the bottom of our pretend nest.
Weave the sides to hold our nest together.
Add soft grass to line our pretend nest.
Settle three pretend eggs gently inside.
Our cozy nest is ready! Watch real nests from far away and leave them undisturbed.
Let's build a doghouse! Start with the walls of our pretend doghouse.
Add a roof above the walls.
Make a doorway for our dog to walk through.
Add a bone-shaped welcome sign.
You built a doghouse with walls, a roof, and a doorway!
Let's build a cat toy! Choose the soft ball for our pretend cat toy.
Add colorful fabric stripes to the ball.
Add a bright round patch.
Decorate the patch with a star.
A colorful soft ball for a playful cat!
Let's build a pet bed! Choose the wide base for our pet bed.
Put a soft cushion inside the bed.
Lay a cozy blanket over the cushion.
Add a little pillow.
Our pet bed has a soft place to rest!
Let's build a rabbit tunnel! Start with a long pretend tunnel.
Add the opening at the far end.
Add the opening at the near end.
Put a soft mat below the tunnel.
Two open ends make a tunnel our rabbit can explore!
Let's build a little bridge! Set two supports under our pretend bridge.
Lay the deck across the supports.
Add the rail posts above the deck.
Put the handrail across the posts.
Our little bridge connects one side to the other!
Let's build a flower box! Choose a box for our pretend flowers.
Fill the box with soil.
Add three green stems.
Add the bright flowers to the stems.
Three colorful flowers brighten our flower box!
Let's build a bug hotel! Start with the frame of our pretend bug hotel.
Add shelves inside the frame.
Fill the shelves with little hollow tubes.
Put a sheltering roof on top.
Our pretend bug hotel has little spaces to hide!
Let's build a toy boat! Choose the hull, the bottom of our toy boat.
Stand the mast in the middle.
Add a bright sail beside the mast.
Add a little flag at the top.
A hull, a mast, and a sail! Our toy boat is ready for pretend adventures!
Let's build a picnic table! Set the legs of our pretend picnic table.
Put the wide tabletop on the legs.
Add a bench on each side.
Spread a colorful tablecloth on top.
Our picnic table is ready for a pretend picnic!
